scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @stellora/backend" "npm run dev -w @stellora/frontend" "npm run dev -w @stellora/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stellora/frontend && npm run build -w @stellora/admin
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @stellora/backend" "npm run start -w @stellora/frontend" "npm run start -w @stellora/admin"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @stellora/backend && npm run typecheck -w @stellora/frontend && npm run typecheck -w @stellora/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @stellora/frontend && npm run lint -w @stellora/admin
